BiblicalUsage: Jeconiah = "Jehovah will establish"; 1) son of king Jehoiakim of Judah and king of Judah for 3 months and 10 days before he surrendered to Nebuchadnezzar and was taken captive to Babylon where he was imprisoned for the next 36 years; released at the death of Nebuchadnezzar and lived in Babylon until his death; 1a) primary spelling 'Jehoiachin'
